description: This PHP file contains a unit test class for the CandidateShortlistingAPI in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It includes tests for API endpoints such as getOne, getValidationRuleForGetOne, update, delete, and getValidationRuleForDelete, and sets up test fixtures and mock services.

classes.name: CandidateShortlistingAPITest

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the update operation of the API with given test case parameters.
